title: Tanzanian Passion Fruit Juice
community: Tanzania — the highland passion fruit turned into the country's finest juice
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Tanzanian Passion Fruit Juice — fresh passion fruit pulp strained and diluted with cold water, sweetened with honey, and served over ice. Tanzania's most aromatic juice — the highland passion fruit produces a juice of extraordinary fragrance and intensity that no other fruit can match.
longDesc: Tanzania is one of the world's finest passion fruit producers — the highland altitude and rich volcanic soil produce passion fruits of exceptional fragrance and acidity. The juice made from these fruits needs minimal intervention: strain, dilute, sweeten lightly with honey, and serve cold. It is the finest fruit juice in East Africa.
ingredients: // Optional: a few passion fruit seeds left in for visual effect
steps: Halve passion fruits. Scoop pulp and seeds into a sieve over a bowl.
Press through the sieve with the back of a spoon, extracting all the juice. Discard seeds.
Add cold water, honey, and salt to the strained juice.
Taste — adjust sweetness. The juice should be tart and intensely fragrant.
chefTips: Press the sieve pulp hard — every drop of the juice remaining in the pulp is the most concentrated.
Honey complements passion fruit far better than sugar.
Serve very cold — the fragrance is most pronounced when cold.
commonMistakes: Not pressing the sieve pulp thoroughly — losing the most concentrated juice.
Over-sweetening — the tartness is the point.
cookingScience: Passion fruit contains terpenes (particularly linalool and geraniol) — volatile aromatic compounds that are more soluble at cold temperatures. Serving the juice cold maximises the aromatic intensity perceived as the volatile compounds evaporate from the cold liquid surface into the nose. These same compounds are largely destroyed by heating.
sustainabilityTips: Tanzania's highland passion fruit — one of the country's most profitable export crops, here consumed at the source.
servedWith: As a palate cleanser between courses
healthBenefits: Rich in vitamin A and beta-carotene.
Passion fruit contains harman alkaloids — mood-improving compounds.
High in fibre (if some pulp retained).
culturalNote: Tanzanian passion fruit juice is the drink that makes international visitors understand what 'fresh juice' means. From the same country that exports passion fruit to European supermarkets, drunk as a fresh juice at the source, it tastes like no passion fruit product available anywhere else in the world.
